title: Test HTTP connectivity using a browser or curl
objective: Validate that the web server responds to client requests with valid content.
rationale: Functional testing confirms that DNS resolution (if applicable) and HTTP responses are working correctly.
expected_output: A successful HTTP 200 response containing the default 'Welcome to nginx!' page or similar.
success_criteria: curl -I http://localhost returns an HTTP/1.1 200 OK status code.
